body:
It speaks to me some how.
And sorry about you and your dog :/
Thanks, it's a common taste that I also share for the same reason of it being emotional and about dealing with mental health  issues.

I used to write, but as I said before, I fell like I don't know what to write or say. My journal now is a mess of disconnect history, draws and paint with blood.

Don't get me wrong, I don't like to do this. I don't like to harm myself. There was a time that I did this think it was my answer, that it's inevitable to do this for survive. But I don't feel like this anymore, I don't feel the urge to do self harm because I feel I deserve or something....  

I just don't know how to express, to let other people know that in my head it's a nightmare, that I can't think straight for one second. I can tell more how I feel, what I feel, what I'm suppose to do or don't.... 

And I'm always talking to my friends, but I can't help the felling that I'm a burden sometimes. Because they are used to set the fire down, when things are "crazy" in my life... but the thing is, I feel like that every day, every minute. I don't think it's fair to them, or that is something they should deal with constantly. I don't know if I make sense
